stem.text: In an experiment, water waves in a ripple tank are incident on a gap, as shown.

stem.alt: Ripple tank diagram: parallel vertical wavefronts travelling right towards a gap between two grey barriers, with an arrow showing the direction of travel.

stem.text: Some diffraction of the water waves is observed.
Which change to the experiment would provide a better demonstration of diffraction?

A.text: Increase the amplitude of the waves.

B.text: Increase the frequency of the waves.

C.text: Increase the wavelength of the waves.

D.text: Increase the width of the gap.
